title: Notifications
subtitle: Alerts pushed to e-mail, phones, chat and home automation

typeHelp.email: Plain text mail through your SMTP server, STARTTLS or implicit TLS.
typeHelp.ntfy: Push to the ntfy app on a phone; a click opens the alert.
typeHelp.gotify: Message to a Gotify application; the token goes in the X-Gotify-Key header.
typeHelp.matrix: Message from a bot account into a Matrix room the bot has joined.
typeHelp.webhook: JSON POST of the pelagos.notification.v1 payload, optionally signed with HMAC-SHA256.
typeHelp.home_assistant: Webhook trigger of a Home Assistant automation; the payload is in trigger.json.

status.dispatchOff: Sending is turned off in Settings, Notifications: nothing leaves.
status.splitNote: Only the first online node of the sender order sends. If the nodes lose sight of each other, each side sends: a duplicate is possible, never a silence.

mute.title: Mute every channel
mute.help: For a maintenance: nothing is sent until the end, then one digest of the alerts still open.
mute.dialogHelp: Every channel holds its messages until the end of the mute (24 hours at most). The reason goes in the audit.
mute.liftBody: Channels send again; a digest of the alerts still open leaves now.

failed.title_one: {{count}} channel keeps failing: its alert goes through the other channels
failed.title_other: {{count}} channels keep failing: their alerts go through the other channels

empty.title: No channel yet
empty.help: Add one to receive alerts without opening the interface.

order.title: Sender order
order.help: The first online node sends. When it goes down, the next one takes over after three missed polls.

fields.roomIdHelp: The !id:server of the room, not an alias
fields.hmacHelp: With a secret, X-Pelagos-Signature is sha256=HMAC of "<X-Pelagos-Timestamp>.<body>"; refuse timestamps older than 5 minutes.
fields.haHelp: Home Assistant answers 200 to an unknown webhook id: check the automation runs after a test.
fields.caPemHelp: For a server signed by a private CA. Certificate checks always stay on.
fields.reminderHelp: For an open alert nobody acknowledged; 0: never
fields.confirmHelp: Empty: the cluster setting; critical alerts never wait
fields.quietHelp: Messages wait and leave as one digest at the end
fields.ntfyOpen: Without authentication, anyone who knows the topic reads the messages.

errors.urlCredentials: Credentials go in the secret fields, not in the URL
errors.loopbackOnly: Without TLS, only toward a loopback address
errors.room: A room id (!opaque:server), not an alias
errors.header: One "Name: value" per line, valid header names
errors.headerReserved: This header is set by Pelagos
errors.reenter: The server changed: enter the secret again or remove it

warnings.plainHttp: Plain http carries the secret unencrypted
warnings.noTls: No TLS: messages travel in clear

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: The channel and its stored secrets are removed from every node. Its history stays in the audit.
